links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated and society patient education vs recommended sixth to eighth grade level
links.effect: All sources exceeded the recommended sixth to eighth grade reading level; professional society materials most readable (median SMOG 11.275; Flesch-Kincaid 9.005); Gemini least understandable (3.2).
links.quote: While professional society materials remained the most readable, all sources exceeded the recommended sixth to eighth grade reading level.
